      ledgerPrefix = "ledger." ++ account

    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".credits", jNum credits)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_side", JStr balanceSide)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_amount", jNum balanceAmount)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".side", JStr balanceSide)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".amount", jNum balanceAmount)
    ]

  jFlatDerived
    ( concat
        [ balanceFields "AccountsPayable" 0 200000
        , balanceFields "AccountsReceivable" 300000 0
        , balanceFields "CapitalStock" 0 2000000
        , balanceFields "Cash" 2000000 cashPaidTotal
        , balanceFields "DepositsReceived" 0 withholdingTotal
        , balanceFields "Fixtures" 500000 0

        , ("financial_statements.net_income", jNum netIncome)
        , ( "financial_statements.balance_check"
          , jNum (totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity)
          )
        ]
    )

main =

    Right value ->
      emitObject
        [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg value))
        , ("derived", RawComp derivedValue)
        ]

        posting["amount"]
        for posting in journal

    )

        for posting in journal
        if posting["account"] == account and posting["side"] == "credit"
    )

total_revenue = 0
total_expenses = totals["Purchases"]["debit"] - totals["Purchases"]["credit"]

total_equity = opening_equity + net_income

derived["financial_statements.total_revenue"] = total_revenue
derived["financial_statements.total_expenses"] = total_expenses
derived["financial_statements.net_income"] = net_income
derived["financial_statements.balance_check"] = (
    total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity
)

print(json.dumps({"journal": journal, "derived": derived}, separators=(",", ":")))

    ("e7", 900, "Cash"),
    ("e8", 500, "Cash"),
    ("e9", 5000, "Cash"),
    ("e10", 1300, "Cash"),

for txid, amount, settlement_account in transactions:
    journal.append({
        "txid": txid,
        "side": "debit",
        "account": "Purchases",
        "amount": amount,
    })
    journal.append({
        "txid": txid,
        "side": "credit",
        "account": settlement_account,
        "amount": amount,
    })

accounts = [
    "AccountsPayable",
    "AccountsReceivable",
    "CapitalStock",
    "Cash",
    "Fixtures",
    "MerchandiseInventory",
    "Purchases",
    "RetainedEarnings",
]

totals = {
    account: {"debit": 0, "credit": 0}
    for account in accounts
}

for posting in journal:
    account = posting["account"]
    if account in totals:
        totals[account][posting["side"]] += posting["amount"]

derived = {}

for account in accounts:
    debits = totals[account]["debit"]
    credits = totals[account]["credit"]

    if debits > credits:
        balance_side = "debit"
        balance_amount = debits - credits
    elif credits > debits:
        balance_side = "credit"
        balance_amount = credits - debits
    else:
        balance_side = "zero"
        balance_amount = 0

    derived[f"ledger.{account}.debits"] = debits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.credits"] = credits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_amount"] = balance_amount
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.amount"] = balance_amount

total_assets = (
    derived["ledger.AccountsReceivable.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.Cash.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.Fixtures.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.MerchandiseInventory.balance_amount"]
)

opening_equity = (
    derived["ledger.CapitalStock.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.RetainedEarnings.balance_amount"]
)
total_revenue = 0
total_expenses = derived["ledger.Purchases.balance_amount"]
net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
total_equity = opening_equity + net_income
balance_check = total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity

derived["financial_statements.total_assets"] = total_assets

    ("e1", 3500, "AccountsPayable"),

    ("e3", 4100, "AccountsPayable"),
    ("e4", 2700, "Cash"),

    ("e8", 700, "Cash"),
    ("e9", 2400, "Cash"),
    ("e10", 2600, "AccountsPayable"),
]

journal = [
    {"txid": "opening", "side": side, "account": account, "amount": amount}
    for side, account, amount in opening_balances
]

for txid, amount, payment_account in transactions:
    journal.append({
        "txid": txid,
        "side": "debit",
        "account": "Purchases",
        "amount": amount,
    })
    journal.append({
        "txid": txid,
        "side": "credit",
        "account": payment_account,
        "amount": amount,
    })

accounts = [
    "AccountsPayable",
    "AccountsReceivable",
    "CapitalStock",
    "Cash",
    "Fixtures",
    "MerchandiseInventory",
    "Purchases",
    "RetainedEarnings",
]

derived = {}

for account in accounts:
    debits = sum(
        posting["amount"]
        for posting in journal
        if posting["account"] == account and posting["side"] == "debit"
    )
    credits = sum(
        posting["amount"]
        for posting in journal
        if posting["account"] == account and posting["side"] == "credit"
    )

    if debits > credits:
        balance_side = "debit"
        balance_amount = debits - credits
    elif credits > debits:
        balance_side = "credit"
        balance_amount = credits - debits
    else:
        balance_side = "zero"
        balance_amount = 0

    derived[f"ledger.{account}.debits"] = debits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.credits"] = credits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_amount"] = balance_amount
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.amount"] = balance_amount

total_assets = (
    derived["ledger.Cash.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.AccountsReceivable.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.MerchandiseInventory.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.Fixtures.balance_amount"]
)
total_liabilities = derived["ledger.AccountsPayable.balance_amount"]
opening_equity = (
    derived["ledger.CapitalStock.balance_amount"]
    + derived["ledger.RetainedEarnings.balance_amount"]
)
total_revenue = 0
total_expenses = derived["ledger.Purchases.balance_amount"]
net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
total_equity = opening_equity + net_income

derived["financial_statements.total_assets"] = total_assets
derived["financial_statements.total_liabilities"] = total_liabilities
derived["financial_statements.opening_equity"] = opening_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_equity"] = total_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_revenue"] = total_revenue
derived["financial_statements.total_expenses"] = total_expenses
derived["financial_statements.net_income"] = net_income
derived["financial_statements.balance_check"] = (

    "AccumulatedDepreciation",
    "Cash",
    "ConsumptionTaxReceived",
    "DepositsReceived",
    "Depreciation",
    "InterestExpense",
    "Purchases",
    "Sales",
    "WageExpenditure"
]

    account: {"debit": 0, "credit": 0}
    for account in accounts
}

    totals[posting["account"]][posting["side"]] += posting["amount"]

derived = {}

for account in accounts:
    debits = totals[account]["debit"]
    credits = totals[account]["credit"]
    difference = debits - credits

    if difference > 0:
        balance_side = "debit"
        balance_amount = difference
    elif difference < 0:
        balance_side = "credit"
        balance_amount = -difference
    else:
        balance_side = "zero"
        balance_amount = 0

    derived[f"ledger.{account}.debits"] = debits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.credits"] = credits
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"ledger.{account}.balance_amount"] = balance_amount
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.side"] = balance_side
    derived[f"trial_balance.{account}.amount"] = balance_amount

    for account in (
        "Depreciation",
        "InterestExpense",
        "Purchases",
        "WageExpenditure"
    )
)

net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
opening_equity = total_assets - total_liabilities - net_income
total_equity = opening_equity + net_income
balance_check = total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity

derived["financial_statements.total_assets"] = total_assets
derived["financial_statements.total_liabilities"] = total_liabilities
derived["financial_statements.opening_equity"] = opening_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_equity"] = total_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_revenue"] = total_revenue
derived["financial_statements.total_expenses"] = total_expenses
derived["financial_statements.net_income"] = net_income
derived["financial_statements.balance_check"] = balance_check

accountTotals :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> (MoneyDecimal, MoneyDecimal)
accountTotals target tx = foldr addPosting (0, 0) (toList tx)
  where
    addPosting posting (debits, credits)
      | getAccountTitle (_hatBase posting) /= target = (debits, credits)
      | whichSide (_hatBase posting) == Debit =
          (debits + _val posting, credits)
      | otherwise =
          (debits, credits + _val posting)

debitNet :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> MoneyDecimal
debitNet account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
  in debits - credits

creditNet :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> MoneyDecimal
creditNet account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
  in credits - debits

balanceSide :: MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal -> String
balanceSide debits credits
  | debits > credits = "debit"
  | credits > debits = "credit"
  | otherwise = "zero"

balanceAmount :: MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal
balanceAmount debits credits
  | debits >= credits = debits - credits
  | otherwise = credits - debits

moneyValue :: MoneyDecimal -> JVal
moneyValue = jNum . toDecimal

accountDerived :: String -> AccountTitles -> MinTx -> [(String, JVal)]
accountDerived label account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
      side = balanceSide debits credits
      amount = balanceAmount debits credits
      ledgerPrefix = "ledger." ++ label
      trialPrefix = "trial_balance." ++ label
  in
    [ (ledgerPrefix ++ ".debits", moneyValue debits)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".credits", moneyValue credits)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_side", JStr side)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_amount", moneyValue amount)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".side", JStr side)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".amount", moneyValue amount)
    ]

  let totalAssets =
        debitNet Cash tx
          + debitNet AccountsReceivable tx
          + debitNet AccumulatedDepreciation tx
      totalLiabilities =
        creditNet AccountsPayable tx
          + creditNet AccruedExpenses tx
          + creditNet ConsumptionTaxReceived tx
          + creditNet DepositsReceived tx
      openingEquity = 0
      totalRevenue = creditNet Sales tx
      totalExpenses =
        debitNet Depreciation tx
          + debitNet InterestExpense tx
          + debitNet Purchases tx
          + debitNet WageExpenditure tx
      netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
      totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome
      balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity
  in
    [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", moneyValue totalAssets)
    , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", moneyValue totalLiabilities)
    , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", moneyValue openingEquity)
    , ("financial_statements.total_equity", moneyValue totalEquity)
    , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", moneyValue totalRevenue)
    , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", moneyValue totalExpenses)
    , ("financial_statements.net_income", moneyValue netIncome)
    , ("financial_statements.balance_check", moneyValue balanceCheck)
    ]

derivedValues :: MinTx -> [(String, JVal)]
derivedValues tx =
  concatMap
    (\(label, account) -> accountDerived label account tx)
    [ ("AccountsPayable", AccountsPayable)
    , ("AccountsReceivable", AccountsReceivable)
    , ("AccruedExpenses", AccruedExpenses)
    , ("AccumulatedDepreciation", AccumulatedDepreciation)
    , ("Cash", Cash)
    , ("ConsumptionTaxReceived", ConsumptionTaxReceived)
    , ("DepositsReceived", DepositsReceived)
    , ("Depreciation", Depreciation)
    , ("InterestExpense", InterestExpense)
    , ("Purchases", Purchases)
    , ("Sales", Sales)
    , ("WageExpenditure", WageExpenditure)
    ]
  ++ financialDerived tx

main :: IO ()
main =
  case givenJournal of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right journal ->
      let tx = toAlg journal
      in emitObject
           [ ("journal", JournalComp tx)
           , ("derived", RawComp (jFlatDerived (derivedValues tx)))
           ]

givenJournal
  :: Either
       (NE.NonEmpty (JournalError String MoneyDecimal))
       MinJournal
givenJournal = checkedJournal givenRows

accountTotals :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> (MoneyDecimal, MoneyDecimal)
accountTotals target tx = foldr addPosting (0, 0) (toList tx)
  where
    addPosting posting (debits, credits)
      | getAccountTitle (_hatBase posting) /= target = (debits, credits)
      | whichSide (_hatBase posting) == Debit =
          (debits + _val posting, credits)
      | otherwise =
          (debits, credits + _val posting)

debitNet :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> MoneyDecimal
debitNet account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
  in debits - credits

creditNet :: AccountTitles -> MinTx -> MoneyDecimal
creditNet account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
  in credits - debits

balanceSide :: MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal -> String
balanceSide debits credits
  | debits > credits = "debit"
  | credits > debits = "credit"
  | otherwise = "zero"

balanceAmount :: MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal -> MoneyDecimal
balanceAmount debits credits
  | debits >= credits = debits - credits
  | otherwise = credits - debits

moneyValue :: MoneyDecimal -> JVal
moneyValue = jNum . toDecimal

accountDerived :: String -> AccountTitles -> MinTx -> [(String, JVal)]
accountDerived label account tx =
  let (debits, credits) = accountTotals account tx
      side = balanceSide debits credits
      amount = balanceAmount debits credits
      ledgerPrefix = "ledger." ++ label
      trialPrefix = "trial_balance." ++ label
  in
    [ (ledgerPrefix ++ ".debits", moneyValue debits)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".credits", moneyValue credits)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_side", JStr side)
    , (ledgerPrefix ++ ".balance_amount", moneyValue amount)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".side", JStr side)
    , (trialPrefix ++ ".amount", moneyValue amount)
    ]

financialDerived :: MinTx -> [(String, JVal)]
financialDerived tx =
  let totalAssets =
        debitNet Cash tx
          + debitNet AccountsReceivable tx
          + debitNet AccumulatedDepreciation tx
      totalLiabilities =
        creditNet AccountsPayable tx
          + creditNet AccruedExpenses tx
          + creditNet ConsumptionTaxReceived tx
          + creditNet DepositsReceived tx
      openingEquity = 0
      totalRevenue = creditNet Sales tx
      totalExpenses =
        debitNet Depreciation tx
          + debitNet InterestExpense tx
          + debitNet Purchases tx
          + debitNet WageExpenditure tx
      netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
      totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome
      balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity
  in
    [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", moneyValue totalAssets)
    , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", moneyValue totalLiabilities)
    , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", moneyValue openingEquity)
    , ("financial_statements.total_equity", moneyValue totalEquity)
    , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", moneyValue totalRevenue)
    , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", moneyValue totalExpenses)
    , ("financial_statements.net_income", moneyValue netIncome)
    , ("financial_statements.balance_check", moneyValue balanceCheck)
    ]

derivedValues :: MinTx -> [(String, JVal)]
derivedValues tx =
  concatMap
    (\(label, account) -> accountDerived label account tx)
    [ ("AccountsPayable", AccountsPayable)
    , ("AccountsReceivable", AccountsReceivable)
    , ("AccruedExpenses", AccruedExpenses)
    , ("AccumulatedDepreciation", AccumulatedDepreciation)
    , ("Cash", Cash)
    , ("ConsumptionTaxReceived", ConsumptionTaxReceived)
    , ("DepositsReceived", DepositsReceived)
    , ("Depreciation", Depreciation)
    , ("InterestExpense", InterestExpense)
    , ("Purchases", Purchases)
    , ("Sales", Sales)
    , ("WageExpenditure", WageExpenditure)
    ]
  ++ financialDerived tx

main :: IO ()
main =
  case givenJournal of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right journal ->
      let tx = toAlg journal
      in emitObject
           [ ("journal", JournalComp tx)
           , ("derived", RawComp (jFlatDerived (derivedValues tx)))
           ]

toMoneyPosting :: RawPosting -> (Side, AccountTitles, MoneyDecimal)
toMoneyPosting (side, account, amount) =
  (side, account, fromIntegral amount)

journalData
  :: Either
       (NE.NonEmpty (JournalError String MoneyDecimal))
       MinJournal
journalData =
  checkedJournal
    [ (txid, [toMoneyPosting posting | posting <- postings])
    | (txid, postings) <- rawRows
    ]

debits :: AccountTitles -> Int
debits target =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rawRows
    , (Debit, account, amount) <- postings
    , account == target
    ]

credits :: AccountTitles -> Int
credits target =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rawRows
    , (Credit, account, amount) <- postings
    , account == target
    ]

balanceSide :: AccountTitles -> String
balanceSide account
  | debits account > credits account = "debit"
  | credits account > debits account = "credit"
  | otherwise = "zero"

balanceAmount :: AccountTitles -> Int
balanceAmount account =
  abs (debits account - credits account)

accountDerived :: String -> AccountTitles -> [(String, JVal)]
accountDerived label account =
  [ ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".debits", jInt (debits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".credits", jInt (credits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".balance_side", JStr (balanceSide account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".balance_amount", jInt (balanceAmount account))
  , ("trial_balance." ++ label ++ ".side", JStr (balanceSide account))
  , ("trial_balance." ++ label ++ ".amount", jInt (balanceAmount account))
  ]

netDebit :: AccountTitles -> Int
netDebit account = debits account - credits account

netCredit :: AccountTitles -> Int
netCredit account = credits account - debits account

totalAssets :: Int
totalAssets =
  netDebit Cash
    + netDebit AccountsReceivable
    + netDebit AccumulatedDepreciation

totalLiabilities :: Int
totalLiabilities =
  netCredit AccountsPayable
    + netCredit AccruedExpenses
    + netCredit ConsumptionTaxReceived
    + netCredit DepositsReceived

totalRevenue :: Int
totalRevenue = netCredit Sales

totalExpenses :: Int
totalExpenses =
  netDebit Depreciation
    + netDebit InterestExpense
    + netDebit Purchases
    + netDebit WageExpenditure

netIncome :: Int
netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses

openingEquity :: Int
openingEquity =
  totalAssets - totalLiabilities - netIncome

totalEquity :: Int
totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome

balanceCheck :: Int
balanceCheck =
  totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity

derivedValue :: JVal
derivedValue =
  jFlatDerived
    ( concat
        [ accountDerived "AccountsPayable" AccountsPayable
        , accountDerived "AccountsReceivable" AccountsReceivable
        , accountDerived "AccruedExpenses" AccruedExpenses
        , accountDerived "AccumulatedDepreciation" AccumulatedDepreciation
        , accountDerived "Cash" Cash

        , accountDerived "DepositsReceived" DepositsReceived
        , accountDerived "Depreciation" Depreciation
        , accountDerived "InterestExpense" InterestExpense
        , accountDerived "Purchases" Purchases
        , accountDerived "Sales" Sales
        , accountDerived "WageExpenditure" WageExpenditure
        ]
        ++ [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", jInt totalAssets)
           , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", jInt totalLiabilities)
           , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", jInt openingEquity)
           , ("financial_statements.total_equity", jInt totalEquity)
           , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", jInt totalRevenue)
           , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", jInt totalExpenses)
           , ("financial_statements.net_income", jInt netIncome)
           , ("financial_statements.balance_check", jInt balanceCheck)
           ]
    )

main :: IO ()
main =
  case journalData of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right journal ->
      emitObject
        [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg journal))

toMoneyPosting :: RawPosting -> (Side, AccountTitles, MoneyDecimal)
toMoneyPosting (side, account, amount) =
  (side, account, fromIntegral amount)

journalData
  :: Either
       (NE.NonEmpty (JournalError String MoneyDecimal))
       MinJournal
journalData =
  checkedJournal
    [ (txid, [toMoneyPosting posting | posting <- postings])
    | (txid, postings) <- rawRows
    ]

debits :: AccountTitles -> Int
debits target =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rawRows
    , (Debit, account, amount) <- postings
    , account == target
    ]

credits :: AccountTitles -> Int
credits target =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rawRows
    , (Credit, account, amount) <- postings
    , account == target
    ]

balanceSide :: AccountTitles -> String
balanceSide account
  | debits account > credits account = "debit"
  | credits account > debits account = "credit"
  | otherwise = "zero"

balanceAmount :: AccountTitles -> Int
balanceAmount account =
  abs (debits account - credits account)

accountDerived :: String -> AccountTitles -> [(String, JVal)]
accountDerived label account =
  [ ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".debits", jInt (debits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".credits", jInt (credits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".balance_side", JStr (balanceSide account))
  , ("ledger." ++ label ++ ".balance_amount", jInt (balanceAmount account))
  , ("trial_balance." ++ label ++ ".side", JStr (balanceSide account))
  , ("trial_balance." ++ label ++ ".amount", jInt (balanceAmount account))
  ]

netDebit :: AccountTitles -> Int
netDebit account = debits account - credits account

netCredit :: AccountTitles -> Int
netCredit account = credits account - debits account

totalAssets :: Int
totalAssets =
  netDebit Cash
    + netDebit AccountsReceivable
    + netDebit AccumulatedDepreciation

totalLiabilities :: Int
totalLiabilities =
  netCredit AccountsPayable
    + netCredit AccruedExpenses
    + netCredit ConsumptionTaxReceived
    + netCredit DepositsReceived

totalRevenue :: Int
totalRevenue = netCredit Sales

totalExpenses :: Int
totalExpenses =
  netDebit Depreciation
    + netDebit InterestExpense
    + netDebit Purchases
    + netDebit WageExpenditure

netIncome :: Int
netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses

openingEquity :: Int
openingEquity =
  totalAssets - totalLiabilities - netIncome

totalEquity :: Int
totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome

balanceCheck :: Int
balanceCheck =
  totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity

derivedValue :: JVal
derivedValue =
  jFlatDerived
    ( concat
        [ accountDerived "AccountsPayable" AccountsPayable
        , accountDerived "AccountsReceivable" AccountsReceivable
        , accountDerived "AccruedExpenses" AccruedExpenses
        , accountDerived "AccumulatedDepreciation" AccumulatedDepreciation
        , accountDerived "Cash" Cash
        , accountDerived "ConsumptionTaxReceived" ConsumptionTaxReceived
        , accountDerived "DepositsReceived" DepositsReceived
        , accountDerived "Depreciation" Depreciation
        , accountDerived "InterestExpense" InterestExpense
        , accountDerived "Purchases" Purchases
        , accountDerived "Sales" Sales
        , accountDerived "WageExpenditure" WageExpenditure
        ]
        ++ [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", jInt totalAssets)
           , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", jInt totalLiabilities)
           , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", jInt openingEquity)
           , ("financial_statements.total_equity", jInt totalEquity)
           , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", jInt totalRevenue)
           , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", jInt totalExpenses)
           , ("financial_statements.net_income", jInt netIncome)
           , ("financial_statements.balance_check", jInt balanceCheck)
           ]
    )

main :: IO ()
main =
  case journalData of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right journal ->
      emitObject
        [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg journal))
        , ("derived", RawComp derivedValue)
        ]

        amount = values[0]
        post(txid, "debit", "Purchases", amount)
        post(txid, "credit", "Cash", amount)
    elif kind == "accrued_interest":
        amount = values[0]
        post(txid, "debit", "InterestExpense", amount)
        post(txid, "credit", "AccruedExpenses", amount)
    elif kind == "wages":
        gross, cash_paid, withholding = values
        post(txid, "debit", "WageExpenditure", gross)
        post(txid, "credit", "Cash", cash_paid)
        post(txid, "credit", "DepositsReceived", withholding)
    elif kind == "taxable_sale":
        gross, base, tax = values
        post(txid, "debit", "Cash", gross)
        post(txid, "credit", "Sales", base)
        post(txid, "credit", "ConsumptionTaxReceived", tax)

    difference = debits - credits

        balance_amount = difference
    elif difference < 0:
        balance_side = "credit"
        balance_amount = -difference
    else:

        "Purchases",
        "WageExpenditure",
    )
)
net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
opening_equity = total_assets - total_liabilities - net_income
total_equity = opening_equity + net_income
balance_check = total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity

derived["financial_statements.total_assets"] = total_assets
derived["financial_statements.total_liabilities"] = total_liabilities
derived["financial_statements.opening_equity"] = opening_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_equity"] = total_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_revenue"] = total_revenue
derived["financial_statements.total_expenses"] = total_expenses
derived["financial_statements.net_income"] = net_income
derived["financial_statements.balance_check"] = balance_check

journal = []
for txid, postings in transactions:
    for side, account, amount in postings:
        journal.append({
            "txid": txid,
            "side": side,
            "account": account,
            "amount": amount
        })

accounts = [
    "AccountsPayable",
    "AccountsReceivable",
    "AccruedExpenses",
    "AccumulatedDepreciation",
    "Cash",
    "ConsumptionTaxReceived",
    "DepositsReceived",
    "Depreciation",
    "InterestExpense",
    "Purchases",
    "Sales",
    "WageExpenditure"
]

totals = {
    account: {"debit": 0, "credit": 0}
    for account in accounts
}

for posting in journal:
    totals[posting["account"]][posting["side"]] += posting["amount"]

derived = {}
for account in accounts:
    debits = totals[account]["debit"]
    credits = totals[account]["credit"]
    difference = debits - credits

    if difference > 0:
        balance_side = "debit"
        balance_amount = difference
    elif difference < 0:
        balance_side = "credit"
        balance_amount = -difference
    else:
        balance_side = "zero"
        balance_amount = 0

    derived["ledger." + account + ".debits"] = debits
    derived["ledger." + account + ".credits"] = credits
    derived["ledger." + account + ".balance_side"] = balance_side
    derived["ledger." + account + ".balance_amount"] = balance_amount
    derived["trial_balance." + account + ".side"] = balance_side
    derived["trial_balance." + account + ".amount"] = balance_amount

    totals["Cash"]["debit"] - totals["Cash"]["credit"]

total_liabilities = sum(
    totals[account]["credit"] - totals[account]["debit"]
    for account in [
        "AccountsPayable",
        "AccruedExpenses",
        "ConsumptionTaxReceived",
        "DepositsReceived"
    ]

total_revenue = totals["Sales"]["credit"] - totals["Sales"]["debit"]

total_expenses = sum(
    totals[account]["debit"] - totals[account]["credit"]
    for account in [
        "Depreciation",
        "InterestExpense",
        "Purchases",
        "WageExpenditure"
    ]
)

net_income = total_revenue - total_expenses
opening_equity = total_assets - total_liabilities - net_income
total_equity = opening_equity + net_income
balance_check = total_assets - total_liabilities - total_equity

derived["financial_statements.total_assets"] = total_assets
derived["financial_statements.total_liabilities"] = total_liabilities
derived["financial_statements.opening_equity"] = opening_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_equity"] = total_equity
derived["financial_statements.total_revenue"] = total_revenue
derived["financial_statements.total_expenses"] = total_expenses
derived["financial_statements.net_income"] = net_income
derived["financial_statements.balance_check"] = balance_check

import ExchangeAlgebra hiding (map)
import ExchangeAlgebra.Convert.Checked
  ( EntryError
  , JournalError
  , checkedEntry
  , checkedJournal
  , exactBalanced
  )
import ExchangeAlgebra.Assist (explainJournalErrors)
import ExchangeAlgebra.Journal (Journal, toAlg)
import EmitCanonical
import qualified Data.List.NonEmpty as NE
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import System.IO (stderr)

type MinBase = HatBase AccountTitles
type MinTx = Alg MoneyDecimal MinBase
type MinJournal = Journal String MoneyDecimal MinBase

rows :: [(String, [(Side, AccountTitles, MoneyDecimal)])]
rows =
  [ ( "opening"
    , [ (Debit, Cash, 2000000)
      , (Debit, AccountsReceivable, 300000)
      , (Debit, MerchandiseInventory, 150000)
      , (Debit, Fixtures, 500000)
      , (Credit, AccountsPayable, 200000)
      , (Credit, CapitalStock, 2000000)
      , (Credit, RetainedEarnings, 750000)
      ]
    )
  , ("e1",  [(Debit, Cash, 1870), (Credit, Sales, 1700), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 170)])
  , ("e2",  [(Debit, Cash, 3850), (Credit, Sales, 3500), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 350)])
  , ("e3",  [(Debit, Cash, 2310), (Credit, Sales, 2100), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 210)])
  , ("e4",  [(Debit, Cash, 8910), (Credit, Sales, 8100), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 810)])
  , ("e5",  [(Debit, Cash, 6380), (Credit, Sales, 5800), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 580)])
  , ("e6",  [(Debit, Cash, 3300), (Credit, Sales, 3000), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 300)])
  , ("e7",  [(Debit, Cash, 6820), (Credit, Sales, 6200), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 620)])
  , ("e8",  [(Debit, Cash, 6270), (Credit, Sales, 5700), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 570)])
  , ("e9",  [(Debit, Cash, 9020), (Credit, Sales, 8200), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 820)])
  , ("e10", [(Debit, Cash, 6710), (Credit, Sales, 6100), (Credit, ConsumptionTaxReceived, 610)])
  ]

journal :: Either (NE.NonEmpty (JournalError String MoneyDecimal)) MinJournal
journal = checkedJournal rows

debits :: AccountTitles -> MoneyDecimal
debits account =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rows
    , (side, title, amount) <- postings
    , side == Debit
    , title == account
    ]

credits :: AccountTitles -> MoneyDecimal
credits account =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (_, postings) <- rows
    , (side, title, amount) <- postings
    , side == Credit
    , title == account
    ]

openingCredits :: AccountTitles -> MoneyDecimal
openingCredits account =
  sum
    [ amount
    | (txid, postings) <- rows
    , txid == "opening"
    , (side, title, amount) <- postings
    , side == Credit
    , title == account
    ]

ledgerBalance :: AccountTitles -> (String, MoneyDecimal)
ledgerBalance account =
  case compare debitTotal creditTotal of
    GT -> ("debit", debitTotal - creditTotal)
    LT -> ("credit", creditTotal - debitTotal)
    EQ -> ("zero", 0)
  where
    debitTotal = debits account
    creditTotal = credits account

balanceAmountOf :: AccountTitles -> MoneyDecimal
balanceAmountOf = snd . ledgerBalance

moneyValue :: MoneyDecimal -> JVal
moneyValue = jNum . toDecimal

accountFields :: String -> AccountTitles -> [(String, JVal)]
accountFields accountName account =
  [ ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".debits", moneyValue (debits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".credits", moneyValue (credits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".balance_side", JStr balanceSide)
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".balance_amount", moneyValue balanceAmount)
  , ("trial_balance." ++ accountName ++ ".side", JStr balanceSide)
  , ("trial_balance." ++ accountName ++ ".amount", moneyValue balanceAmount)
  ]
  where
    (balanceSide, balanceAmount) = ledgerBalance account

derived :: JVal
derived =
  jFlatDerived $
    concat
      [ accountFields "AccountsPayable" AccountsPayable
      , accountFields "AccountsReceivable" AccountsReceivable
      , accountFields "CapitalStock" CapitalStock
      , accountFields "Cash" Cash
      , accountFields "ConsumptionTaxReceived" ConsumptionTaxReceived
      , accountFields "Fixtures" Fixtures
      , accountFields "MerchandiseInventory" MerchandiseInventory
      , accountFields "RetainedEarnings" RetainedEarnings
      , accountFields "Sales" Sales
      ]
      ++
      [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", moneyValue totalAssets)
      , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", moneyValue totalLiabilities)
      , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", moneyValue openingEquity)
      , ("financial_statements.total_equity", moneyValue totalEquity)
      , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", moneyValue totalRevenue)
      , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", moneyValue totalExpenses)
      , ("financial_statements.net_income", moneyValue netIncome)
      , ("financial_statements.balance_check", moneyValue balanceCheck)
      ]
  where
    totalAssets =
      sum
        [ balanceAmountOf Cash
        , balanceAmountOf AccountsReceivable
        , balanceAmountOf MerchandiseInventory
        , balanceAmountOf Fixtures
        ]
    totalLiabilities =
      balanceAmountOf AccountsPayable
        + balanceAmountOf ConsumptionTaxReceived
    openingEquity =
      openingCredits CapitalStock
        + openingCredits RetainedEarnings
    totalRevenue = balanceAmountOf Sales
    totalExpenses = 0
    netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
    totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome
    balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity

main :: IO ()
main =
  case journal of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right checked ->
      if exactBalanced (toAlg checked)
        then
          emitObject
            [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg checked))
            , ("derived", RawComp derived)
            ]
        else exitFailure

    , side == Credit
    , title == account
    ]

ledgerBalance :: AccountTitles -> (String, MoneyDecimal)
ledgerBalance account =
  case compare debitTotal creditTotal of
    GT -> ("debit", debitTotal - creditTotal)
    LT -> ("credit", creditTotal - debitTotal)
    EQ -> ("zero", 0)
  where
    debitTotal = debits account
    creditTotal = credits account

balanceAmountOf :: AccountTitles -> MoneyDecimal
balanceAmountOf = snd . ledgerBalance

moneyValue :: MoneyDecimal -> JVal
moneyValue = jNum . toDecimal

accountFields :: String -> AccountTitles -> [(String, JVal)]
accountFields accountName account =
  [ ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".debits", moneyValue (debits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".credits", moneyValue (credits account))
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".balance_side", JStr balanceSide)
  , ("ledger." ++ accountName ++ ".balance_amount", moneyValue balanceAmount)
  , ("trial_balance." ++ accountName ++ ".side", JStr balanceSide)
  , ("trial_balance." ++ accountName ++ ".amount", moneyValue balanceAmount)
  ]
  where
    (balanceSide, balanceAmount) = ledgerBalance account

derived :: JVal
derived =
  jFlatDerived $
    concat
      [ accountFields "AccountsPayable" AccountsPayable
      , accountFields "AccountsReceivable" AccountsReceivable
      , accountFields "CapitalStock" CapitalStock
      , accountFields "Cash" Cash
      , accountFields "ConsumptionTaxReceived" ConsumptionTaxReceived
      , accountFields "Fixtures" Fixtures
      , accountFields "MerchandiseInventory" MerchandiseInventory
      , accountFields "RetainedEarnings" RetainedEarnings
      , accountFields "Sales" Sales
      ]
      ++
      [ ("financial_statements.total_assets", moneyValue totalAssets)
      , ("financial_statements.total_liabilities", moneyValue totalLiabilities)
      , ("financial_statements.opening_equity", moneyValue openingEquity)
      , ("financial_statements.total_equity", moneyValue totalEquity)
      , ("financial_statements.total_revenue", moneyValue totalRevenue)
      , ("financial_statements.total_expenses", moneyValue totalExpenses)
      , ("financial_statements.net_income", moneyValue netIncome)
      , ("financial_statements.balance_check", moneyValue balanceCheck)
      ]
  where
    totalAssets =
      sum
        [ balanceAmountOf Cash
        , balanceAmountOf AccountsReceivable
        , balanceAmountOf MerchandiseInventory
        , balanceAmountOf Fixtures
        ]
    totalLiabilities =
      balanceAmountOf AccountsPayable
        + balanceAmountOf ConsumptionTaxReceived
    openingEquity =
      openingCredits CapitalStock
        + openingCredits RetainedEarnings
    totalRevenue = balanceAmountOf Sales
    totalExpenses = 0
    netIncome = totalRevenue - totalExpenses
    totalEquity = openingEquity + netIncome
    balanceCheck = totalAssets - totalLiabilities - totalEquity

main :: IO ()
main =
  case journal of
    Left errs ->
      TIO.hPutStrLn stderr (explainJournalErrors errs) >> exitFailure
    Right checked ->
      if exactBalanced (toAlg checked)
        then
          emitObject
            [ ("journal", JournalComp (toAlg checked))
            , ("derived", RawComp derived)
            ]
        else exitFailure
